+var envReference = regexp.MustCompile(`^\$\{[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\}$`)

+// envSubstitutionHookFunc resolves a whole-value environment reference before
+// other hooks convert the resulting string to its destination type.
+func envSubstitutionHookFunc() mapstructure.DecodeHookFuncKind {
+	return func(from reflect.Kind, _ reflect.Kind, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+		if from != reflect.String {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		value := data.(string)
+		if !envReference.MatchString(value) {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		if resolved, ok := os.LookupEnv(value[2 : len(value)-1]); ok {
+			return resolved, nil
+		}
+
+		return data, nil
+	}
+}

Added an exact `${VARIABLE_NAME}` substitution hook at the start of `DecodeHooks`. Existing decode hooks can then convert resolved values to types such as ports and durations. Missing variables, non-string values, and strings that do not match the full pattern remain unchanged; existing `FLIPT_` overrides still take precedence.

Added tests for those cases and multiple references in one YAML file. `go test ./internal/config ./config -count=1` passed.
